definitions.short: Aroër , the name of three places in or near Palestine
definitions.full: H6177. Aroer II. עֲרֹעֵר 10 , עֲרוֺעֵר 5 , עַרְעֹר 1 proper name, of a location Αροηρ , MI 26 ערער ; — 1 city on north bank of Arnon, southern limit of east Jordan Israel, עֲרֹעֵר Num 32:34 (JE), Deut 2:36 ; 3:12 ; 4:48 ; Josh 12:2 (D) 2Kin 10:33 ; 1Chr 5:8 ; עֲרוֺעֵר Josh 13:9 (D), 13:16 (P), 2Sam 24:5 ; Moabitish Jer 48:19 (compare MI 26 ); once עַרְעֹר Judg 11:26 ; modern `Ar`âir Buhl Geogr. 269, Tristr Moab 129 ff. 2 city near Rabbah in Ammon , עֲרֹעֵר Judg 11:33 , ׳עֲרוֺ Josh 13:25 (P), site unknown. 3 city in southern Judah , עֲרֹעֵר 1Sam 30:28 ( ᵐ5 Αροηρ + Αμμαδει , latter originally according to We, indicating form ערערה ; ᵐ5 L Παγουηλ ); + Josh 15:22 reading ׳ע (or עַרְעָרָה ) for ᵐ5 עַדְעָרָה, ᵑ0 B Αρουηλ , We 1Sam 30:28 (compare Dr HPS), Di on the passage Benn Steuern; possibly `Ar`âra approximately 9 miles south of east from Beersheba, but compare Buhl Geogr. 183. — Isa 17:2 read ᵐ5 עַד עֲדֵי עָרֶיהָ Lo Lag Semitic i. 30 Che Buhl Lex and others (for עֲרֹעֵר עָרֵי ᵑ0 ). — See also Che Ency. Bib. 317 .
